leaders.LEADER_AMINA: Amina of Zazzau, your authority travels with the caravans. Secure the roads, strengthen the cities, and make prosperity a source of lasting power.
leaders.LEADER_ASHOKA: Ashoka, an empire may be won by conquest, yet held by compassion. Let the welfare of your people become the measure of your reign.
leaders.LEADER_ASHOKA_ALT: Ashoka, the ambitions of kings leave deep marks upon the world. Weigh every victory against its cost, and build a realm worthy of enduring.
leaders.LEADER_AUGUSTUS: Augustus, order rises from the ruins of civil war. Build institutions that outlive their founder, and turn the strength of Rome towards a lasting peace.
leaders.LEADER_BENJAMIN_FRANKLIN: Benjamin Franklin, curiosity can illuminate a nation. Bring invention into public service, and let diplomacy accomplish what force alone cannot.
leaders.LEADER_CATHERINE: Catherine, the horizons of your empire are wide, but its future must be cultivated. Give learning a home, and let culture speak with authority.
leaders.LEADER_CHARLEMAGNE: Charlemagne, divided kingdoms await a common purpose. Unite power with learning, and lay foundations that the centuries may inherit.
leaders.LEADER_CONFUCIUS: Confucius, the character of a state begins with the conduct of its people. Cultivate wisdom, honour responsibility, and make good government an everyday practice.
leaders.LEADER_FRIEDRICH: Friedrich, discipline is most valuable when it serves clear judgement. Guard your realm with resolve, and give its people room to prosper.
leaders.LEADER_FRIEDRICH_ALT: Friedrich, strength and refinement need not be strangers. Let the arts flourish beside the sciences, and make achievement more enduring than spectacle.
leaders.LEADER_HARRIET_TUBMAN: Harriet Tubman, freedom begins with the courage to act. Protect those who depend upon you, and make solidarity a strength no tyrant can command.
leaders.LEADER_HATSHEPSUT: Hatshepsut, the Nile sustains your people, but ambition carries them beyond its banks. Open the routes of trade, and build monuments to shared prosperity.
leaders.LEADER_HIMIKO: Himiko, trust can bind a realm more firmly than fear. Tend the relationships that sustain your authority, and guide your people through uncertainty.
leaders.LEADER_HIMIKO_ALT: Himiko, a sovereign's voice carries both promise and responsibility. Bring rival interests into balance, and make cooperation the foundation of your rule.
leaders.LEADER_IBN_BATTUTA: Ibn Battuta, every journey reveals another way to live. Follow the roads between cultures, and turn discovery into understanding.
leaders.LEADER_ISABELLA: Isabella, your kingdom stands at the threshold of a wider world. Prepare its fleets, strengthen its institutions, and consider carefully the legacy of expansion.
leaders.LEADER_JOSE_RIZAL: Jose Rizal, ideas can awaken a people before armies ever march. Defend learning and dignity, and give your nation the confidence to shape its future.
leaders.LEADER_LAFAYETTE: Lafayette, liberty asks more than an inspiring declaration. Build alliances, defend public trust, and make freedom secure in the life of the nation.
leaders.LEADER_MACHIAVELLI: Machiavelli, power rewards those who understand its workings. Read the moment clearly, choose your allies carefully, and remember that stability must be earned.
leaders.LEADER_PACHACUTI: Pachacuti, the mountains challenge every ambition. Join distant communities with roads and purpose, and make the heights a foundation rather than a barrier.
leaders.LEADER_TRUNG_TRAC: Trung Trac, resistance begins when a people refuses to surrender its future. Lead with courage, and turn determination into a lasting independence.
leaders.LEADER_XERXES: Xerxes, the resources of a great empire rest in your hands. Coordinate its strength wisely, and let each province find a place within your purpose.
leaders.LEADER_XERXES_ALT: Xerxes, imperial grandeur is sustained by more than royal command. Nurture exchange across your lands, and make abundance an instrument of unity.
leaders.LEADER_ADA_LOVELACE: Ada Lovelace, imagination can perceive possibilities that calculation has not yet reached. Unite rigorous thought with invention, and open new paths for human knowledge.
leaders.LEADER_ALEXANDER: Alexander, ambition draws you beyond familiar frontiers. Lead boldly, but build connections strong enough to survive the passing of a conqueror.
leaders.LEADER_BOLIVAR: Simon Bolivar, independence is the beginning of a nation's work, not its conclusion. Unite resolve with institution building, and give liberty the means to endure.
leaders.LEADER_EDWARD_TEACH: Edward Teach, reputation travels swiftly across the sea. Master the opportunities of the coast, and remember that even audacity depends upon preparation.
leaders.LEADER_ELIZABETH: Elizabeth, your island kingdom looks towards an uncertain horizon. Balance counsel with conviction, and let commerce, culture, and seamanship extend its influence.
leaders.LEADER_GENGHIS_KHAN: Genghis Khan, the steppe rewards speed, organisation, and resolve. Unite scattered strengths, and make the movement of people and knowledge part of your legacy.
leaders.LEADER_GILGAMESH: Gilgamesh, a city becomes great through the lives it protects. Build its walls, honour its people, and seek a legacy beyond personal glory.
leaders.LEADER_LAKSHMIBAI: Lakshmibai, sovereignty is tested when its defenders face impossible choices. Stand resolute, protect your people, and make courage a common inheritance.
leaders.LEADER_NAPOLEON: Napoleon, decisive action can remake the balance of a continent. Organise your resources with precision, and give ambition the discipline it requires.
leaders.LEADER_NAPOLEON_ALT: Napoleon, the energies of revolution demand direction. Turn opportunity into effective institutions, and judge every triumph by what it leaves behind.
leaders.LEADER_SAYYIDA_AL_HURRA: Sayyida al Hurra, the coast is a meeting place of commerce and power. Command its routes, defend your independence, and negotiate from a position of strength.
leaders.LEADER_TECUMSEH: Tecumseh, unity gives scattered communities a stronger voice. Build a common purpose, protect the land, and let cooperation sustain your people's independence.
leaders.LEADER_TOYOTOMI_HIDEYOSHI: Toyotomi Hideyoshi, a divided country offers neither security nor lasting prosperity. Bring its resources together, and turn hard won authority towards durable order.
leaders.LEADER_WASHINGTON: George Washington, a republic must learn to govern after it has learned to resist. Guard public trust, strengthen its foundations, and place duty before personal power.
leaders.LEADER_YI_SUN_SIN: Yi Sun Sin, preparation can overturn the advantage of greater numbers. Know your waters, preserve your fleet, and make steadfast leadership your strongest defence.

civilizations.CIVILIZATION_ABBASID: The Abbasid world draws strength from scholarship and exchange. Gather knowledge across distant horizons, and make your cities meeting places of invention.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_AKSUM: Aksum stands between the highlands and the sea. Connect the routes of trade, and let the prosperity of your crossroads sustain an enduring kingdom.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_AMERICA: America's future takes shape through invention, migration, and public ambition. Build connections across the land, and turn opportunity into a prosperity that can endure.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_ASSYRIA: Assyria's cities unite organisation, craftsmanship, and formidable strength. Build a realm whose learning and institutions can stand beside its military achievements.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_BABYLON: Babylon rises where careful observation meets urban ambition. Cultivate knowledge, strengthen your cities, and give discovery a place in the life of the state.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_BUGANDA: Buganda's communities flourish through organisation and exchange. Strengthen the relationships between your settlements, and make cooperation a source of regional influence.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_BULGARIA: Bulgaria stands where empires and traditions meet. Defend your independence, cultivate learning, and give your people institutions worthy of their resilience.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_CARTHAGE: Carthage looks to the sea for opportunity. Build a network of thriving ports, and make commerce the foundation of a power that reaches beyond the coast.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_CHOLA: The Chola realm joins fertile lands to far reaching maritime connections. Sustain your cities, strengthen your fleets, and let exchange carry your influence abroad.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_DAI_VIET: Dai Viet draws resilience from its communities and landscapes. Defend the river valleys, cultivate their abundance, and make independence a living tradition.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_EGYPT: Egypt's story begins with the rhythms of the Nile. Organise its abundance, nurture its cities, and build works that speak across the centuries.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_ENGLAND: England's institutions grow through contest, adaptation, and exchange. Develop the towns and ports, and turn an island's connections into lasting influence.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_FRENCH_EMPIRE: The French Empire joins administrative ambition to cultural prestige. Organise the nation, encourage innovation, and weigh expansion against the demands of stability.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_GAUL: The communities of Gaul bring skilled craftsmanship and deep regional connections. Strengthen their settlements, and turn local resourcefulness into a shared political purpose.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_GORYEO: Goryeo cultivates scholarship, artistry, and capable government. Support the workshops and schools, and give your kingdom the confidence to endure changing times.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_GREAT_BRITAIN: Great Britain stands at the meeting of industry and maritime exchange. Connect invention with commerce, and consider the responsibilities that accompany global influence.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_GREECE: Greece's cities find strength in argument, artistry, and exchange. Cultivate civic life, and let competition inspire achievements greater than any single city.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_HAN: The Han realm depends upon the careful organisation of a vast land. Strengthen its administration, sustain its farms, and keep the roads of exchange open.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_HAWAII: Hawaii's islands are joined by seamanship, knowledge, and community. Steward their resources carefully, and make the ocean a connection rather than a boundary.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_HEIAN: Heian Japan cultivates a rich world of literature and courtly expression. Sustain its communities, and let refinement become part of a broader cultural legacy.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_ICELAND: Iceland's settlements meet a demanding landscape with resourcefulness. Sustain their independence, strengthen the bonds of community, and learn what the northern seas can offer.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_INCA: The Inca realm turns mountain distances into an organised network. Join its communities with roads and careful stewardship, and make cooperation a source of remarkable strength.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_JOSEON: Joseon places learning at the heart of government. Invest in scholarship and practical invention, and make knowledge useful throughout the life of the kingdom.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_KHMER: The Khmer realm transforms water management into the foundation of urban life. Sustain the fields and reservoirs, and let careful planning support great cultural achievements.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_MAJAPAHIT: Majapahit thrives among the connected islands of Southeast Asia. Strengthen maritime exchange, nurture your cities, and give a diverse realm a common direction.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_MAURYA: The Mauryan realm brings a vast region under organised government. Coordinate its resources wisely, and let public welfare become part of imperial strength.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_MAYA: Maya cities cultivate intricate traditions of knowledge, artistry, and authority. Develop their connections, sustain their landscapes, and give achievement a lasting home.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_MEIJI: Meiji Japan faces rapid change with disciplined ambition. Build institutions that can support new industries, and join technical progress to an enduring sense of purpose.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_MEXICO: Mexico's future draws upon deep traditions and the work of building a nation. Strengthen its communities, encourage invention, and let cultural confidence sustain its development.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_MING: The Ming realm joins administrative reach to skilled production. Sustain the cities and countryside together, and make sound institutions the foundation of prosperity.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_MISSISSIPPIAN: Mississippian communities build thriving centres within a connected river landscape. Sustain their farms and gathering places, and strengthen the relationships that give them influence.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_MONGOLIA: Mongolia's steppe networks turn mobility into far reaching power. Organise your forces, protect the routes of exchange, and let connection extend beyond conquest.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_MUGHAL: The Mughal realm brings diverse traditions into a rich imperial setting. Support craftsmanship and exchange, and make effective government a partner to cultural splendour.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_NEPAL: Nepal's valleys connect communities across a demanding mountain landscape. Sustain their craftsmanship and exchange, and turn the challenges of geography into enduring strengths.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_NORMAN: The Norman realm combines adaptation with forceful ambition. Build durable institutions in newly connected lands, and make authority effective beyond the moment of conquest.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_OTTOMANS: The Ottoman realm grows through organisation across many peoples and regions. Coordinate its resources, sustain its cities, and make administration as capable as its armies.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_PERSIA: Achaemenid Persia draws strength from connecting a diverse empire. Maintain its roads, cultivate capable government, and give distant provinces a share in common prosperity.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_PIRATE_REPUBLIC: The Republic of Pirates seeks opportunity beyond the authority of distant empires. Master the sea routes, strengthen your havens, and turn uncertain fortunes into lasting security.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_PRUSSIA: Prussia cultivates discipline, education, and organised state power. Develop its institutions, encourage practical knowledge, and make preparation the foundation of achievement.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_QAJAR: Qajar Persia stands between deep traditions and a changing international order. Strengthen its institutions, nurture commerce, and choose carefully how your realm meets the wider world.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_QING: The Qing realm governs a vast and diverse landscape. Sustain its productive communities, coordinate its administration, and meet changing circumstances with clear judgement.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_ROME: Rome's influence grows through roads, institutions, and civic ambition. Build connections that outlive their builders, and make the strength of the state useful to its people.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_RUSSIA: Russia's great distances demand connection and resolve. Develop its cities, support learning and industry, and give the breadth of the land a shared direction.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_SENGOKU: Sengoku Japan faces the challenge of rival authorities and uncertain alliances. Organise your resources, secure your communities, and turn competition towards a lasting settlement.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_SHAWNEE: Shawnee communities draw strength from relationships, stewardship, and determination. Protect their independence, sustain the land, and make cooperation a source of resilience.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_SIAM: Siam flourishes where diplomacy, exchange, and cultural confidence meet. Strengthen its cities, cultivate capable government, and preserve room for independent judgement.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_SILLA: Silla brings political ambition into partnership with craftsmanship and learning. Strengthen the foundations of unity, and give your people a cultural legacy that endures.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_SONGHAI: Songhai's river routes connect productive lands to centres of trade and learning. Secure those connections, sustain your cities, and make exchange the basis of regional power.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_SPAIN: Spain looks beyond familiar shores with maritime ambition. Prepare its fleets and institutions, and remember that the reach of power also widens its responsibilities.
civilizations.CIVILIZATION_TONGA: Tonga's ocean networks depend upon skill, exchange, and organised leadership. Connect the islands, care for their resources, and let seamanship sustain a thriving realm.
